name: Select
layerWhy: It is one field whose answer is one option; a primitive part of a form.
promise: One answer from a known list, chosen by pointing or by the keyboard.
expectation: A field with a chevron that opens a list Primal draws, the chosen option checked.
evidence: The list sits against the field, the active option is shaded and the chosen one checked; the native select keeps the value for forms and autofill.
behaviour: Opens on click, Enter, Space or ↓; arrows move; typing jumps; Escape closes.
context: Five or more options. Fewer: radios.
relationships: Its label is the question; the options are answers.
accessibility: combobox and listbox roles; aria-activedescendant follows the active option.
do: Put the most common answer where the eye lands.
dont: A select for yes or no.

usage.markup:
<primal-field label="Country">
  <primal-select>
    <select primalControl required>
      <option value="">Choose a country</option>
      <option value="il">Israel</option>
    </select>
  </primal-select>
</primal-field>
